主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced on March 13, 2015, that it had completed a going private transaction involving Brookfield Residential. The filing, submitted as a Form 6-K to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, indicated that the company had filed the necessary documents for the transaction. The report was signed by A.J. Silber, the Corporate Secretary of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. The filing was incorporated by reference into the Registration Statement of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. on Form F-10 (File No. 333-198444). This transaction marked a significant shift in the company's strategy, moving it towards a private ownership structure.
